description: Print mode (default bundle, subagents on by default): the model delegates with the Agent tool. Agent runs in the background by default (core step 9, 4c), so the parent's turn ends while a real child process (the same app, --mode json --task-id) answers from the same mock LLM. The child's result arrives as a follow-up notification at the next turn boundary, and the parent's final answer builds on it.
args: Ask a subagent what 6 times 7 is.

arguments.prompt: What is 6 times 7? Reply with the number only.

llm.text: The subagent is running in the background. I will report its answer when it finishes.

normalize._comment: the pool task id is Date.now() plus random base36

pinned hoocode never exits after a print-mode run that dispatched a subagent: the lifeguard's setInterval is not unref'd, so its event loop stays alive (hoocode bug, ledger 10.9f). hoocode exits 0; only a clean exit is dropped, a failing one still shows.
